trumpNote: TRUMPS ARE NOT JUST THE TRUMP SUIT: every {{level}} in all four suits and all four jokers are trumps too. High to low: red joker > black joker > trump-suit level card > off-suit level cards > plain trumps.
pointsLine: THE DEFENDERS (team {{team}}) COLLECT THE POINTS. They hold {{points}}; {{target}} takes the deal (of {{total}} in the pack).
declareRules: Declare trump by showing a level card. ONLY A STRONGER SHOWING OVERRIDES (a pair beats a single). If everyone passes there is no trump suit.
kittyRules: Bury {{count}} cards back into the kitty. KEEP YOUR POINTS AND TRUMPS OUT: if the defenders take the last trick, the kitty's points reach them multiplied.
handHeldLine: The declarers held ({{points}} of {{target}} to the defenders). Team {{team}} climbs {{advance}} level(s)
handTakenLine: The defenders collected {{points}} ({{target}} or more). The deal changes hands and team {{team}} climbs {{advance}} level(s)
kittyLine: Kitty: {{points}} points (x{{mult}}) went to the defenders

tutorial.info: This hand's level and trump suit. Every card of the level rank is a trump, and the defenders are the side that collects points.
tutorial.players: Each seat's team, and whether it is declaring or defending. Partners sit opposite each other.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Select a single, a pair, or a tractor (consecutive pairs) and play it.
tutorial.actions: You must follow the led suit while you hold it. The trump group counts as one suit.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game at any time with this button.

hint.shengji_declare: You hold a level card, so you can name the trump suit. Showing a pair overrides a single showing.
hint.shengji_pass: You hold no level card, so you cannot declare. Passing is fine — if everyone passes there is no trump suit.
hint.shengji_bury: Keep the 5s, 10s, kings and your trumps out of the kitty. If the defenders take the last trick its points reach them multiplied.
hint.shengji_hold: You are declaring. Do not chase points — keep the tricks carrying them away from the defenders.
hint.shengji_collect: You are defending, and defenders are the side that scores. Collect the 5s, 10s and kings; 80 takes the deal.
